CHEVAL_GRAND_SLAY_KEYWORD_STAMINA.title: Stamina
CHEVAL_GRAND_SLAY_KEYWORD_STAMINA.descri: Each play consumes 1 Stamina. Stamina carries over between combats. At 0 Stamina, the card enters the [gold]Rest Pile[/gold], until you recover it.
CHEVAL_GRAND_SLAY_KEYWORD_REST_PILE.desc: Stamina cards enter this pile when they run out of Stamina. Cards and powers can restore their Stamina and move them out.
